nu (indecl.) [Ved. nu, Idg. *nu, orig. adv. of time=now; cp. Lat. num (to nunc, now), see nūna] affirm.--indef. part. "then, now." -- 1. most freq. combd with interr. pron. and followed by kho, as kin nu kho J II.159; kacci J I.279; kaccin nu (for kaccid nu) J II.133; kathan nu (kho) Vin I.83; kattha PvA 22; etc. -- 2. as interr. part. (=Lat. ne, num) in enclitic position Vin I.17; J III.52; Sn 866, 871, 1071; etc. As such also combd with na=nanu (Lat. nonne), which begins the sentence: Vin II.303. (nanu tvaṃ vuḍḍho vīsativasso "sī ti?); Pv I.84; PvA 39, 136 etc. -- Often combd with other emphatic or dubitative particles, like api nu Vin II.303; D I.97; nu idha, contr. to nīdha Vv 836 or with sandhi as nu--v--idha D I.108 (v. l. nu khv idha). Cp. na , nūna, no.
